## Implemented & Verified
Real DEV Electron verification of Tariff Display quality gates (`node scripts/tariff-quality-check.mjs` PASS).
- **Loading, empty and error states (`q:states`):** Verified published tariff prices, hospital name header, and currency from live server `GET /tariff`. Category filters (All prices, Ward daily charges, Lab test prices) filter rows correctly. Non-matching query renders `<Empty>` state with explicit guidance message ('No published prices match this view. Show all prices or refresh; a missing price does not mean a free service.'). 'Show all prices' button resets query and category and restores tables.
- **Test plan passed (`q:tested`):** Refresh tariff button executes on-demand `GET /tariff` reload. 'Print / save tariff PDF' downloads `/tariff/pdf` via native bridge; verified file contains valid `%PDF-` header and displays success notice.
- **Contextual F1 help (`q:f1_help`):** Pressing F1 on search input opens Tariff handbook page, restores focus and preserves draft search text.
- **Keyboard zoom 100-250% (`q:zoom`):** Verified bounded zoom at 100% and 250% in Light and DarkHighContrast themes, in both English and Urdu without horizontal overflow. Preferences restored and session signed out cleanly.
- Durable evidence saved in `docs/tariff-quality-evidence-2026-10-24.json`.
